info.name: biblio-checker - Supabase upload + verify (local)
info.description:
Emulates the frontend flow: (1) request signed upload URL from Next.js, (2) upload file to Supabase Storage via signedUrl, (3) call Next.js gateway to download+hash+forward to FastAPI, (4) optional cleanup.

No secrets are required in Postman; Supabase service role key stays server-side (Next.js + FastAPI env vars).

request.description: Calls `POST /api/signed-upload` to receive a Supabase Storage `signedUrl` and a `path` that includes `requestId`.

Uploads the document bytes to Supabase Storage via the signed upload URL.

Notes:
- In the Postman UI, you may need to switch Body to binary/file and select the PDF manually.
- For automation, set `upload_file_path` (absolute or relative) and run with Newman.

Calls `POST /api/analysis-start-gateway`.

Server-side behavior:
- Downloads the uploaded file from Supabase Storage
- Computes SHA256
- Forwards payload to FastAPI `POST /api/analysis/start`
- On error, attempts cleanup in Supabase
Calls `POST /api/cleanup-upload` to delete the uploaded file from Supabase Storage.

item.name: External API Validation
item.description:
Validates that the external APIs used for bibliographic reference verification respond correctly.

Strategies tested:
- OpenAlex: DOI lookup, title search, author+title search, title+author+year, ISSN+volume, title+year
- SciELO: DOI lookup, ISSN search (identifiers → fetch by PID)
- arXiv: ID lookup, DOI search, title search, title+author search

IMPORTANT: Run arXiv requests one at a time (4s delay is built into pre-request scripts).

item.name: arXiv
item.description: arXiv enforces strict rate limits (max 1 request per 3 seconds). Run these requests ONE AT A TIME manually, or use the collection runner with a 4-second delay between requests.

request.description:
Looks up a paper by arXiv ID (Strategy 1). Returns an Atom XML feed with a single entry.

IMPORTANT: Wait at least 3 seconds before running the next arXiv request to avoid HTTP 429.

Expected: XML response with <entry> containing <id>, <title>, <author><name>, <published>.

exec: // arXiv rate limit: wait 4 seconds if a previous arXiv request was made
// Postman doesn't have native sleep, so we use a setTimeout workaround
pm.test("Entry has <id> with arxiv.org URL", function () {
pm.test("Entry has <published> with ISO date", function () {
